name: smoltrace-benchmark-v1
description: smoltrace-benchmark-v1 is a dataset intended to evaluate models on tasks involving short execution traces or micro-traces (e.g., trace understanding, summarization, or classification). It provides compact trace examples designed to stress-model understanding of sequential or temporal patterns in small traces. The benchmark measures model ability to interpret, summarize, or predict properties of these traces.
reputation: A smaller, newer community dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside its initial user base.
